spec.query:
SELECT last("positionAsFloat") 
FROM "default_signals_retention"."StrategySignal" 
WHERE ("strategy"::tag = 'ARB_V2_DEFI_DEFICEFI_AXL_BDM_USDT_Q|H') 
AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval) 
fill(previous)

SELECT last("pnl") FROM "default"."acct_lvl_daily_pnl" WHERE (("label" =~ /^SLN--DEFI--DEFI--DEFICEFI--AXL$/ AND "level" =~ /^(0|1|2|3|4)$/ AND "label"::tag != 'SLN--DEFI')) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level" fill(none)

SELECT median("defi_base_balance_usd_pre_fill") AS "Base Token USD", median("defi_quote_balance_whole_pre_fill") AS "Quote Token", median("notional_usd_pre_fill") AS "Notional USD" FROM "default_defi_retention"."ethereum_defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0" WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

SELECT "tx_hash", "expected_spread_bps", "realized_spread_bps", "gas_fee_bps", "lot_size_usd", "expected_pnl_post_fill", "edge_bps","defi_actual_fill_price" FROM "default_defi_retention"."ethereum_defi_cefi_arbitrage_post_trade" WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "is_buy"::field ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 100
